source:
@@U00357@@
you misbegotten son of Hell,
how the devil did you get in,
if now you cant get out?
How did I manage to delude so vast an intellect?

@@U00359@@
Look closely. Do you see?
It’s improperly drawn. The corner that
points outward has a break in it.

@@U00361@@
That was some piece of luck!
And so you're my prisoner.
What an opportunity!

@@U00363@@
The poodle never noticed when he bounded in,
but now it’s taken on a new complexion.
The devil can’t get out.

@@U00365@@
Then why not go out through the window?

@@U00367@@
Yes, well, ghosts and devils have rules, too.
Where they slip in, they have to slip out.
Going in, we choose; going out, we don't.
And that’s the law.

@@U00369@@
Aha, so even Hell has it’s laws.
Yes, I like that. Who knows,
perhaps we'll make a pact,
a binding one, at that.

@@U00371@@
Whatever we promise you'll enjoy to the full.
You'll have full purchase.
And yet these matters aren't easily settled.
We'll talk it over next time, shall we?
translation:
@@U00357@@
你这个地狱的私生子，
你到底是怎么进来的
如果现在你出不去呢？
我是如何欺骗如此大智慧的人的？

@@U00359@@
仔细看看。你看到了吗？
画得不恰当。那个角落
向外的点有一个中断。

@@U00361@@
这真是运气好啊！
所以你是我的囚犯。
多么好的机会啊！

@@U00363@@
贵宾犬从来没有注意到他跳进来的时候，
但现在它呈现出新的面貌。
魔无法脱身。

@@U00365@@
那为什么不从窗户出去呢？

@@U00367@@
是的，鬼魂和魔鬼也有规则。
他们溜进去的地方，就必须溜出去。
走进去，我们选择；出去，我们不出去。
这就是法律。

@@U00369@@
啊哈，原来地狱也有它的法则啊。
是的，我喜欢这样。谁知道，
也许我们会达成协议
具有约束力的。

@@U00371@@
无论我们承诺什么，您都会充分享受。
您将获得全额购买。
然而这些问题并不容易解决。
我们下次再讨论，好吗？
